:All novices can channel. Novicehood is a stepping-stone during which the person is changed and molded into an Aes Sedai; some will never make it out of novicehood because they are too weak (Morgase Trakand is a good example; she's so weak she likely would never have made Accepted.) Despite that, all novices ''can'' channel to some extent: if someone can't channel and doesn't display the ability through the testing, they don't become a novice.
